Title: ServiceNow Change Request List: Building AND Filter
Description: Workflow for adding multiple AND filter conditions on the Change Request list page.
- Open the filter panel by clicking the 'Show / hide filter' control to reveal the filter inputs.
- Select the first field from the 'All of these conditions must be met. -- choose field --' combobox.
- Click the value combobox (e.g., 'Choose option for field: Type') and select the desired option (e.g., 'Normal').
- If the option click fails, use the 'select_option' action on the value combobox with the specific value string.
- Click the 'Add AND Condition To Condition X' button to append the next filter condition within the AND group.
- For text fields, fill the visible textbox with the required value (e.g., 'System Administrator').
- For empty string conditions, select the field, then use 'select_option' on the operator combobox to choose 'is empty string'.
- Repeat the add-condition and fill steps until all required fields (Type, Requested by, Model, Short description, State) are configured.

Title: ServiceNow Filter UI: Common Pitfalls
Description: High-value observations about field selection, value input, and operator configuration in the filter UI.
- The filter panel is controlled by the 'Show / hide filter' button with bid a47.
- Field selection always uses the combobox labeled 'All of these conditions must be met. -- choose field --'.
- Value selection may require clicking a 'Choose option for field: [Field Name]' combobox instead of direct clicking.
- If clicking an option in the value chooser fails, use the 'select_option' action on the combobox with the exact value string.
- Adding new AND conditions requires clicking the specific button labeled 'Add AND Condition To Condition X: [Previous Condition]'.
- Text values are entered into visible textboxes (e.g., 'Requested by' textbox) rather than dropdowns.
- Empty string conditions require explicitly selecting the operator 'is empty string' from the operator combobox.
- The filter logic defaults to AND ('All of these conditions must be met') within the active group.
